Verified domain sevenstarling.com; Washington, DC-based (launched from New York) virtual women's/perinatal mental health provider, founded by HBS grads Tina Beilinson Keshani (CEO) and Sophia Richter; PearX S20. $2.9M seed co-led by Pear VC, Expa and Magnify Ventures (Sept 2021); $10.9M Series A led by RH Capital (July 2024); $8M Series A-Prime led by Rethink Impact (Sept 2025, per the press release and Mintz). Total about $21.8M. Operates in 18 states and targets 30+ by end of 2026.
